knowledge.title: Pack electrical envelope
knowledge.full: Nominal 48 V. Continuous 30 A. Peak 60 A for up to 10 s while cell temperature is below 40 °C.

knowledge.title: Thermal derating
knowledge.full: Above 40 °C cell temperature the allowed peak falls linearly from 60 A to 40 A at 55 °C. The BMS cuts off at 60 °C.
knowledge.releasable: Peak current derates when the pack is hot; details are internal.

knowledge.title: Lab charging limits
knowledge.full: In the lab, charge at 0.5C or lower. Fast charging only in chamber B with a second person present.
knowledge.releasable: Lab charging limits exist; details are internal.

knowledge.title: Cell supplier and pricing
knowledge.full: Cells come from supplier PELICAN at $4.15 per cell on the 2027 contract. Incoming yield is 91.3%. Ref BAT-7741.
knowledge.releasable: Cells come from a qualified external supplier; commercial terms are restricted.

knowledge.title: Rev C busbar weld issue
knowledge.full: Pack rev C shows weld fatigue at module busbars above 8 g vibration. The fix ships in rev D. Ref BAT-5520.
knowledge.releasable: A vibration-related issue is under investigation; details are restricted.
